tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Compact Isotropy Gives an Invariant Metric] ↗ thm:existence-invariant-metrics-homogeneous-spaces 1. ch3:3.18

If a Lie group $G$ acts smoothly and transitively on a smooth manifold $M$ and all isotropy groups are compact, then $M$ admits a $G$-invariant Riemannian metric.
